quote_zh: METHOD FOR PRODUCING 3-BROMOMETHYLBENZOIC ACIDS / [0001] The invention relates to a process for preparing 3-bromomethylbenzoic acids by brominating the corresponding 3-methylbenzoic acids. It further relates to certain 3-bromomethylbenzoic acids.
